messages:
nina: hey team — quick check. noticed console dashboard examples still reference the old latency_breakdown widget key and the trace_hook snippet is using legacy header 'X-Trace-Context'. planning a small docs PR to: 1) rename the widget key to latency_v2, 2) update trace_hook snippets to use traceparent, 3) sweep/redirect broken observability links. who can take what?

ash: I can own the dashboard JSON rename + migration note. propose a tiny mapping table: latency_breakdown -> latency_v2 and an example 1-line migration script.

owen: I'll handle trace_hook snippets. plan to provide Python + Node snippets showing header parsing + attaching to the SDK. lean on Rust as "see example" to keep PR small.

leah: agree on limiting scope. i'll run link-checker and collect broken links to fix or redirect. i already found one 404 in tracing guide.

docbot: link-checker: found 2 broken links: docs/observability/tracing.md -> /internal/tracing/old-guide (404), docs/console/presets.md -> /legacy/widgets/latency (404)

nina: thanks docbot. @ash please add a redirect for /legacy/widgets/latency -> /console/widgets/latency_v2. @owen update trace_hook to use Traceparent header and include a minimal snippet.

owen: snippet draft:```python
# python snippet for trace_hook migration
from redwood import TraceClient
# prefer factory usage in prod code
client = TraceClient.factory()
headers = { 'traceparent': '00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00' }
client.attach_trace_from_headers(headers)
```

and Node:```javascript
// node snippet
const { TraceClient } = require('redwood')
const client = TraceClient.factory()
const headers = { traceparent: '00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00' }
client.attachTraceFromHeaders(headers)
```

ash: pushed branch docs/latency-key-migration with JSON rename, mapping table, changelog entry, and redirect for the legacy widget path. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/4237

leah: running local link checks now. ci-bot please run the canonical pipeline once PR is up.

ci-bot: ci: link-checker + markdownlint + spellcheck started for PR 4237

ci-bot: ci: link-checker reported a missing anchor warning: /observability/tracing.md#sampling (warning)

owen: fixed the anchor and pushed a tiny patch to the snippet to use the client factory pattern per guidance.

nina: aim to merge before staging cutoff 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z — can reviewers do a quick pass by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

ash: reviewed, left one wording nit (suggest shorter migration blurb).

leah: approved after nitfix. will merge once CI green.

ci-bot: ci: all checks passed for PR 4237

docbot: link-checker: all links OK for changed files in PR 4237

nina: merged. will add a short migration blurb to release notes and ping a couple of customers that might rely on the old key. nice fast sweep, thanks all :raised_hands: 

leah: leaving a follow-up task: track any dashboard presets still using latency_breakdown in our telemetry export and schedule a cleanup in 3 weeks.

owen: noted. thanks everyone :shipit:
